note: Prepared descriptions only. Actual Tapiz cards, dates, authorship and review are not created by this file.

tasks.title: Read own attempt and reject ID substitution
tasks.prerequisites: Trusted account, membership and ATT snapshots; shared decision engine
tasks.acceptance: Owner succeeds; foreign/missing share public 404; no client identity override

tasks.title: Update own draft with validation and atomic version check
tasks.acceptance: Own InProgress draft persists; stale or concurrent write cannot overwrite; history stays immutable

tasks.title: Verify teaching scope and fail closed on provider outage
tasks.acceptance: Teacher cannot read draft or other course; admin cannot bypass; outage denies with no mutation

tasks.title: Model two courses with separate administrative and teaching authority
tasks.prerequisites: Current account provider; seeded explicit course root grants; shared engine
tasks.acceptance: Admin A cannot administer B or read student answers; teacher lacks admin by default

tasks.title: Delegate limited course administration and update settings
tasks.prerequisites: ADM08-01; whitelist and active target checks
tasks.acceptance: Only a same-course root delegates; no self-grant, teaching capability or redelegation

tasks.title: Revoke delegation and reject reused authority
tasks.acceptance: Revocation is course-scoped. Independently authenticated delegate sends the exact cookie issued before revocation, without signing in again, and both read/write deny; captured grant cannot authorize final store operation.

tasks.title: Prepare domain model, matrix, architecture and DFD for both components
useCases: Explain components, data and trust boundaries
tasks.prerequisites: Current implementation and selected specification sections
tasks.acceptance: Two architecture diagrams and two DFDs agree with actual code; unified model and matrix present

tasks.title: Threat model, repeatable seed and metadata-only change audit
tasks.acceptance: Restart restores seed; structured event excludes answers/cookies/secrets

tasks.title: Review at least one provider contract with the actual neighboring team
useCases: Agree ATT snapshot/CAS or identity boundary
tasks.prerequisites: Prepared CONTRACTS.md and real provider owner
tasks.acceptance: Attach acknowledgement URL, reviewer, actual date and reviewed commit; request alone is insufficient

tasks.title: Record actual Tapiz task to branch to PR and green CI
tasks.prerequisites: Create actual cards; clean main-based branch; commit and push
tasks.acceptance: Record actual IDs, branch, new PR URL, tested commit and successful Actions URL

tasks.title: Demonstrate both flows and automated negative cases
tasks.prerequisites: Start AccessKt1 profile; run current code tests
tasks.acceptance: All scripted scenarios pass; preserve actual reports, not expected counts

tasks.title: Integrate real identity, membership and ATT providers
useCases: Use production authenticated subject and ATT storage
tasks.acceptance: Cross-module authorization and CAS remain correct with real providers

tasks.title: Persist grants and course metadata with durable audit
tasks.prerequisites: ADM08-03; agreed root recovery/course metadata contracts
tasks.acceptance: Migrations, grant uniqueness, concurrency and transaction-bound audit; real UI integration
